SELECT PC, NUM, MARKET, VARIABLE, VAL, VS, VS2, COMMENTS, ADD_DATE, DELETE_DATE, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_DATETIME FROM HDOC_USER_DEFINED_RULES WHERE 1=1 AND (PC = #{productClass} OR #{productClass} IS NULL) AND (NUM = #{number} OR #{number} IS NULL) AND (MARKET = #{market} OR #{market} IS NULL) AND (VARIABLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{variable},'%') OR #{variable} IS NULL) AND (VAL LIKE CONCAT('%',#{value},'%') OR #{value} IS NULL) AND (VS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{string1},'%') OR #{string1} IS NULL) AND (VS2 LIKE CONCAT('%',#{string2},'%') OR #{string2} IS NULL) AND (COMMENTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{comments},'%') OR #{comments} IS NULL) GROUP BY PC, NUM, MARKET, VARIABLE, VAL, VS, VS2, COMMENTS, ADD_DATE, DELETE_DATE, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_DATETIME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_USER_DEFINED_RULES (PC, NUM, MARKET, VARIABLE, VAL, VS, VS2, COMMENTS, ADD_DATE, DELETE_DATE, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{pc}, #{num}, #{market}, #{variable}, #{val}, #{vs}, #{vs2}, #{comments}, #{addDate}, #{deleteDate}, #{registerUser}, #{registerDatetime}, #{registerProcess}, #{updateUser}, #{updateDatetime}, #{updateProcess})
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_USER_DEFINED_RULES SET VARIABLE = #{variable}, VAL = #{val}, VS = #{vs}, VS2 = #{vs2}, COMMENTS = #{comments}, ADD_DATE = #{addDate}, DELETE_DATE = #{deleteDate}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_DATETIME = #{updateDatetime}, UPDATE_PROCESS = #{updateProcess} WHERE PC = #{pc} AND NUM = #{num} AND MARKET = #{market}
